latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the Values Clarification & Purpose skill.
- Provides a structured process based on Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT) to help identify and prioritize personal values.
- Includes a values card sort exercise and the “ideal Tuesday” activity to uncover core values in daily life.
- Culturally sensitive guidance—avoids imposing predetermined value hierarchies and respects individual, family, and community choices.
- Useful for those feeling directionless, facing major decisions, or wanting to realign life with authentic values.
